text:
rachel_cs: Quick recap from Pendulum Finance onboarding call, they surfaced 3 product asks + a few pain points. Need triage before renewal discussion next week.

rachel_cs: Asks: 1) per-customer model routing rules (want to route non-sensitive flows to lower-cost model), 2) exportable tamper-evident prompt+response audit logs for compliance, 3) embedding refresh controls (TTL + reindex window) and a simple UI toggle for customer ops.

rachel_cs: Pain points: bursty test traffic caused a ~3x bill spike on day 2, onboarding UI is confusing when creating multi-key/service accounts, and docs are unclear about fallback behavior when Dedicated capacity is down.

rachel_cs: Renewal risk note: customer said "we like Redwood but need clearer cost controls or we'll pause the pilot". @sam_product @diego_engineer can you two weigh in on quick wins?

tasha_csm: +1 on embedding TTL toggle 94 ops asked for that specifically for nightly reindex windows. Also they requested a visual per-route cost estimate while configuring routes (simple projected $).

sam_product: High-level: these are separate workstreams. Quick wins: (a) surface estimated per-route cost in Console (UI + simple heuristics) - low effort, high impact; (b) embedding TTL toggle - medium effort; (c) audit logs are heavier (immutable export + retention).

sam_product: Proposal: ship an S3-compatible weekly manifest export MVP for audit logs to unblock compliance, iterate to KMS/HSM-backed immutability later. Thoughts @diego_engineer?

diego_engineer: Agreed. Rough estimates: cost-estimates UI: ~2 dev days + PM polish. Embedding TTL + toggle: 1 sprint (infra + console + migration). Audit export (S3 manifest) MVP: ~3 sprints (auth, export pipeline, manifest, docs).

diego_engineer: For per-customer routing rules we can reuse existing policy routing table; need UI + validation + safe rollout path. Backend ~2 sprints for safe canary rollout.

rachel_cs: Can we aim to deliver cost-estimate UI + embedding TTL next sprint and start audit export MVP marked as enterprise work in parallel? I'll set expectations with Pendulum if yes.

sam_product: Yes. I'll write a short RFC and slot UI + TTL into next sprint. Audit export -> enterprise backlog with longer lead. Will post RFC link here.

ops_bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1364 (Pendulum onboarding asks). Reviewers: sam_product, diego_engineer, rachel_cs. Draft ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

rachel_cs: Great. I'll tell Pendulum we can deliver cost-estimate UI + TTL toggle next sprint and that audit exports are tracked as enterprise work.

tasha_csm: Pendulum also requested a 30m Console walkthrough for the cost view next Tue. I'll coordinate calendar 94 flagging as enablement request.

sam_product: Add enablement as acceptance criteria for the UI task (30m walkthrough + quickstart doc).

rachel_cs: Thanks team 94 closing loop here. I'll update with customer quote after I confirm renewal meeting. :pray:
